notes.title: Night Witch: 588 Reinforced
notes.content:
Heyo,

So I’ve updated Night Witch: 588. I thought it was fine on release, but after checking it after a gap I realized it just didn’t feel too good to play. Besides, I have learned a lot about making games look good since I released NW588, so I decided to apply some of those fx onto it. In the end, I believe it’s become a better game. It’s not perfect by any means, but it’s certainly enjoyable, unique, and interesting. Oh also, I've thrown in some never heard before voice lines and a loading screen because I'm kind like that.

Without further ado, the patch notes:
- Added a loading screen and extra lines for Natalya
- Added an audio detection delay that’s shorter the louder your engine is
- Increased plane glide distance and speed with the engine turned off
- Increased HP by 25%
- Buffed cannon muzzle velocity
- Added a multitude of post-processing fx to bring some extra visual flair into the game
- Fixed an unholy number of bugs.

Combined, all of these balance changes make the game easier to play stealthily while full speed play takes more skill to dodge cannons, whereas I found that it was actually easier.

The rest of the changes on the other hand were targeted to increase Quality of Life and get the game to feel better in ways you can't do with just balance.

notes.title: Day 4: Inversion & The Future
notes.content:
You asked, we added inverted controls. You can press I during gameplay and your pitch will be inverted on the fly.(pun intended)


[b]Future Updates?[/b]
NW588 is a complete game, but I'll be the first to admit it's sort of rough around the edges. For now, I consider that to be okay. It works, it explains itself, it's fun when you figure it out, it's sufficiently polished for an indie game. Depending on you guys' feedback and love, we might do stuff like add the start of the trailer in as an entry video and more of that sort of cute polish. 

We want to focus on future games and NW588 has not generated enough attention to justify significant work. Especially after our post-launch updates, we are proud of what it is and what we have done. So, if we discover a problem with the game we'll fix it, if there's a simple addition to make it better we'll add it. Just don't hold your breath on anything big.

notes.title: Day 3: Clarity
notes.content:
We updated the game to be easier to get into(still as difficult as always). Restart your Steam if you haven't gotten the update.

Patch notes:
- Added an idle camera animation to the main menu.
- Added a text to pop up on the main menu to explain keyboard controls.
- Added a text to pop up on the game to explain mouse controls.
- Fixed a misspelling of objectives that somehow got through
